profile_text: With a focus on architectural and engineering project planning, this Düsseldorf-based firm has experienced a 21.4% growth in employees, now totaling 17, as it expands its services in Germany. As a specialist in project planning, the company's expertise is in high demand, driving its scaling success. Its presence in Düsseldorf and surrounding areas has enabled it to establish a strong reputation and attract new clients, fueling its rapid expansion.
